ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a fiery 1969 Pittsburgh show, highlighted by soaring Dark Star and The Eleven.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers the raw, burning energy of the February 7‑1970 (likely) Pittsburgh concert with a clear soundboard mix that lets the band’s early‑show jams shine. Reviewers rave about the space‑filled yet thunderous Dark Star and the hard‑charging The Eleven, noting how the late show stitched together much of the Anthem of the Sun material for an unforgettable family vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are 5‑star and uniformly praise both performance (standout jams, iconic songs) and the soundboard capture; no negatives were reported.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced mix that preserves the lo‑fi live intensity of a 1969 show; listeners describe it as “crackling with burning energy” without any noted dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early show is described as tightly jammed and spacey, while the late show weaves in much of the Anthem of the Sun material, creating a cohesive, high‑energy experience that resonated with the massive Pittsburgh hippie crowd.

band_member_comments.Jerry: One reviewer credits Jerry with coining (or popularizing) the term “Dark Star,” and notes his playing as both delicate and thundering within the epic jam.
